title: Your €486 refund is ready
scenario: Your flight was cancelled yesterday. An email with the airline logo, your surname and the correct flight number says a €486 refund is ready, but the payment form expires in 30 minutes.

answers.A: Call the number in your original booking confirmation and ask whether a refund action is pending.
answers.B: Use the email link because the correct flight details show the airline already matched the message to you.
answers.C: Open the airline app or type its website yourself and check the cancelled booking and refund there.

explanation: Correct booking details can be stolen or copied; they do not authenticate the sender. Verification should start outside the message.
proTip: Correct details prove data access, not sender identity.
